newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sigma sees additional sales from new plant.
newsitem.headline: Sigma sees additional sales from new plant.

text.p: A new plant inaugurated in April by Mexican food company Sigma Alimentos will bring additional sales of around 100 million pesos in this first year of operations, a company director said Friday.

Efrain Resendiz said the plant, which is located in the northern city of Linares and has a nominal capacity of 20,000 tonnes of prepared typical Mexican foods, will contribute around 3 percent of revenues this year.
Sigma, a unit of Grupo Industrial Alfa, now has 20 food plants around the country. It specialises in cold meats, but also has lines of cheese and yoghurts.
Revenues in 1996 reached 3.337 billion pesos. Sigma plans to open a cheese plant in 1998. ((-- Daniel Perez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau +528 345 7617))
